relevance.reason: Practical Google Sheets AI feature with cell-level citations — useful everyday AI tool for verifying data

title: Google Workspace Weekly Recap - October 30, 2026
author: Paul Jiménez Vela
content_snippet:
Fill with Gemini now provides cell-level citations for web sources and supports larger requests
We are making it easier to verify your AI-generated data and scale your workflows in Google Sheets. When you use the AI function to generate cell values, Gemini will now provide the exact web sources referenced directly within each individual cell. | Learn more.
Apply compact form layout for pivot tables in Google Sheets
Google Sheets now supports compact form layout for pivot tables, which keeps multi-level pivot tables readable while reducing excessive horizontal scrolling. | Learn more.
Immersive explorations now available in the Gemini app
We’re introducing a library of immersive explorations in the Gemini app, giving users an interactive, visual way to explore topics layer-by-layer, from microscopic systems to deep space. Users can access this library in the Gemini student hub by clicking on “Try immersive explorations” and will soon be able to access these immersive explorations directly in a chat conversation with Gemini. | Learn more.
Create, preview, and edit files directly in the Gemini app
We’re introducing new ways to create and refine files and code in the Gemini app. You can now generate, preview, and edit files right within your Gemini app chat—expand to full screen to type edits directly, highlight text to ask questions, or have Gemini refine them. | Learn more.
Edit entire presentations with Gemini in Google Slides
You can now use Gemini in Google Slides to edit multiple slides or an entire presentation at once. With a single prompt in the Slides side panel, you can update content throughout a deck, refresh visual styles in bulk, or match the style of another presentation. | Learn more.
The announcements above were published on the Workspace Updates blog over the last week. Please refer to the original blog posts for complete details.
